example_sentences_in_bangla: আকাশে অশনিসঙ্কেত দেখা যাচ্ছে, সতর্ক হও।
example_sentences_in_english: Thunderbolt signs are appearing in the sky; be cautious.
The political situation shows signs of an impending thunderbolt.
note: Idiom draws from natural weather phenomena in Bengali folklore, often used metaphorically for sudden calamities.
